plumbing.review:
No blocking findings in this change.

- **Behavior and scope:** The four changed files match the plan. The parser distinguishes missing usage from explicit zero, replaces estimates once, accumulates subsequent reports, preserves thinking stretches, and clears the previous finished state on a new turn ([live.go:364](repo/internal/dashboard/live.go:364), [live.go:407](repo/internal/dashboard/live.go:407), [live.go:447](repo/internal/dashboard/live.go:447)). Both UI locations use full integers, including zero ([app.js:1888](repo/internal/dashboard/web/app.js:1888)).
- **Acceptance tests:** Their source matches the ratified plan. They exercise partial lines, repeated reads, sums, zero, later activity, retained marks, Claude independence, and privacy without implementation special-casing ([acceptance tests:143](repo/internal/dashboard/codex_thinking_accept_test.go:143)). They do not render the UI. Replacement coverage tests truncation only; equal-size/larger replacement detection remains an existing limitation ([live.go:121](repo/internal/dashboard/live.go:121)).
- **Safety and style:** No checks are weakened, and the changes add no network, process, or host access. Only numeric usage and an exactness boolean enter public state; naming, comments, and idioms follow the surrounding code ([live.go:603](repo/internal/dashboard/live.go:603)).
- **Documentation:** README and SPEC explain the behavior and retain the required citations ([README.md:300](repo/README.md:300), [SPEC.md:133](repo/SPEC.md:133)).

The merger must still record the two-way decision refining D-0136 and add its SPEC citation. This is the expressly permitted merger follow-up under [AGENTS.md:6](repo/AGENTS.md:6), not a missing factory implementation change.

The supplied [test report:1](tests.txt:1) reports all checks passing. I did not rerun tests during this read-only review.

VERDICT: approve
